authorization: User direction, 22 October 2026, after a coherence check of the workbook against the project: "I want to leave the pedestal top in the workbook as like a higher resolution dictation of what they could be but we are simplifying for the cad and for construction. If however we needed to grind down to a slope in the future the workbook would have the values." Then: "Yes, record the decision: the workbook keeps the sloped seat planes as the grinding reference, CAD and construction use the D-065 level tops. Add the decision entry, update the D-065 pending-reconciliation wording, note it on the workbook Cover open items, and commit."

finding.summary: The workbook (GEOMETRY-TABLES) chords the cambered soffit over each pad and tabulates sloped pedestal corner elevations; the CAD model (CAD-MODEL) has levelled each pedestal at its former maximum since D-065. The level top at each support equals the workbook's highest corner there, so the level tops sit on or above the sloped planes everywhere.
finding.disposition: Intended difference. The workbook keeps the sloped seat planes as the full-resolution seat record and grinding reference; the CAD model and construction use the D-065 level as-cast tops. Neither is reconciled to the other.
